ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field. Thick black borders along the trailing edge and tips. A prominent vertical black patch extends from the median notch onto the right lobe. The right tip contains a dense cluster of black pigmentation with internal white flecking.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 40 degrees and a bounding box depth reaching into the peduncle connection area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left trailing edge. The right trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude variations, including a significant deep notch (approx. 50 pixels deep) located mid-lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave arc from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white circular clusters are visible on the far-right black distal tip, suggesting barnacle scar constellations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear marks are present on the left lobe: one long diagonal mark in the lower-central region and a series of shorter vertical parallel marks near the upper-left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation or missing tissue chunk on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive linear scarring on the left lobe white field.
other_distinctive_markers: The rightmost distal tip features a unique 'comb-like' or 'ribbed' white-on-black pattern.
